name: Air Differential Pressure Sensor Transmitter (4–20 mA)
shortDescription: Industrial differential pressure transmitter for air and HVAC monitoring.
description: An industrial air differential pressure transmitter with twin barbed ports that measures pressure difference across filters, ducts and cleanrooms. Outputs a standard current signal for PLCs and building management systems.
